'''Plasma fusion triggers''' were weapons of even greater destructive potential than [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They were hard to acquire on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], and illegal even on lawless worlds such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
